card.law_is_about: Renewable-electricity support and conditions for leaving the proposed two-way support scheme.
card.they_want: Allow a permanent exit from support throughout a plant’s operating life.
card.they_claim: The current PPA framework has a maximum duration of five years.
card.the_problem: A contemporary German onshore-wind PPA runs for ten years, but the author may mean only the existing supported-plant opt-out segment.

counter_quote.original: über eine Laufzeit von zehn Jahren
counter_quote.translation_en: Translation of fragment: for a term of ten years

correction: If the statement is meant as a maximum for the whole German PPA market, it is too broad: Statkraft announced a ten-year PPA for a new Schleswig-Holstein onshore wind farm on 16 July 2026. No proved correction is assigned to the narrower opt-out cohort without matched evidence.
effect: Potentially weakens one supporting description of short available income commitments; this is an unresolved scope question, not an established error.
limits: The paragraph specifically concerns existing operating EEG plants leaving support. Different PPA segments have different terms, and a new-build contract does not necessarily establish terms available to an already subsidised plant. A longer contract elsewhere also does not make permanent exit economically attractive or invalidate the request.
context_and_alternatives: The full 32-physical-page submission was read. Earlier printed 11–12 discusses long project-financing needs and buyers’ preference for shorter commitments, providing context against treating every duration reference as a statutory limit.

The strongest benign reading limits the current framework to existing EEG plants considering opt-out. Dena/Pexapark 2025 explicitly distinguishes new-build ten-year contracts from much shorter opt-out and post-EEG contracts.

The submission is dated August 2026 and attached to the Octoberhearing. It has both cabinet and referent-draft covers, while its detailed provisions address the government approach. No exact day within August is inferred.

draft.version: Government cabinet draft 29 July 2026, subsequently BT 21/7867 of 7 September 2026; committee cover 16 October 2026.
draft.version_check: Exact proposed§ 21 e, physical 26, limits the irreversible notice to the end of the tenth calendar year after commissioning. No later law substituted.

materiality_explanation: Potential minor: one supporting market-duration statement; no established project-income or financing error.
